questions.prompt: In logistic regression, what does the model output for each instance?

options.text: The raw score before applying a threshold

questions.explanation: Logistic regression applies a sigmoid to the linear combination of features, producing a probability that the instance belongs to the positive class.

questions.prompt: What is the primary goal of a support vector machine (SVM) when selecting a hyperplane?

options.text: Minimize the distance between the hyperplane and the closest data points
Maximize the margin between the hyperplane and the closest data points
Minimize the number of support vectors
Maximize the classification error on the training data

questions.explanation: An SVM seeks the hyperplane that maximizes the margin—the distance to the nearest support vectors—improving generalization.

questions.prompt: Which metric is commonly used as a splitting criterion in decision trees to measure impurity?
questions.explanation: Decision trees often use Gini impurity (or entropy) to decide the best split by quantifying how mixed the classes are in a node.

questions.prompt: Which regularization term in logistic regression encourages sparsity in the model coefficients?

options.text: Both L1 and L2 penalties together

questions.explanation: L1 regularization adds the absolute value of coefficients to the loss, driving many to zero and creating a sparse model.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the kernel trick in SVMs?

options.text: Reduce the dimensionality of the input space
Map data into a higher-dimensional space to make it linearly separable
Accelerate the training process by using fewer samples
Ensure the data are normally distributed

questions.explanation: The kernel trick computes inner products in a high‑dimensional feature space without explicit mapping, enabling nonlinear decision boundaries.

questions.prompt: Which ensemble method primarily uses bagging to reduce variance in classification?
questions.explanation: Random Forest builds multiple decision trees on bootstrap samples (bagging) and averages their predictions to lower variance.
